items.example: He found a winning ticket on his car and won the lottery.
items.mnemonic: Победитель с вином выиграл в лотерею — win the lottery.

items.example: The couple are ten million dollars richer today.
items.mnemonic: Милиционер стал на миллион богаче — a million dollars richer.

items.translation: деньги растут как грибы / у нас тут золотое дно
items.example: He thinks money grows on trees — he has never worked a day.
items.mnemonic: Лентяй трясёт мани с дерева — money grows on trees, деньги растут.

items.example: He thought he was the unluckiest person in town.
items.mnemonic: Невезучий разлил лак — the unluckiest person in town.

items.idiom: be in the right place at the right time
items.translation: оказаться в нужном месте в нужное время
items.example: He was in the right place at the right time — and he picked up the ticket.
items.mnemonic: Счастливчик попал в рай вовремя — be in the right place at the right time.

items.example: I think I'll give the concert a miss this year.
items.mnemonic: Мисс пропустила концерт — give it a miss, пропустить.

items.example: They didn't want to change their lives, so they started from scratch.
items.mnemonic: Победители клеят скотч и начинают с нуля — start from scratch.
